description: React component for displaying detailed information about a target role, including score, description, skills, responsibilities, and related reports within the 'career navigator' application.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Trims and converts unknown input to string, handling null/undefined values.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Ensures input is an array of strings, normalizing elements.

methods.name: toBulletedSentences
methods.description: Converts an array of strings into cleaned, punctuated sentences.

methods.name: clampPercent
methods.description: Clamps a numeric value between 0 and 100.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Extracts, deduplicates, and normalizes skills from a persona object across various nested fields.

methods.name: normalizeSkillKey
methods.description: Generates a lowercase, trimmed string for skill comparison.

methods.name: intersectSkills
methods.description: Finds common skills between persona skills and required skills, preserving order.
